item.title: Observability At Scale — Every Byte Counts
item.description: 💡 Discover how Wise achieved a 40% reduction in monthly observability costs through five strategic changes! The team focused on enhancing efficiency across their platform, which serves millions globally. Key improvements included optimizing log compression, upgrading metrics collectors, and streamlining query processes. These adjustments not only cut costs but also ensured reliable service delivery for customers. #Efficiency #Observability #Wise #CostReduction #TechInnovation
